milestone: R-M3 controlled-testnet civic and governance closure
closure_policy: implementation plus non-skippable externally generated evidence plus evidence-only direct child

requirements.title: Freeze the correct protocol-wide or group electorate at the controlling block height
requirements.acceptance: Proposal state records the electorate scope, snapshot height, canonical eligible identities or commitment, and fixed denominator before ballots are admitted.

requirements.title: Make the first admitted final ballot immutable
requirements.acceptance: A second ballot, replacement ballot, or vote-revoke transaction from the same voter fails deterministically after the first valid ballot is admitted.

requirements.title: Use frozen denominators and exact integer threshold arithmetic
requirements.acceptance: Quorum and passage results do not change when eligibility changes after snapshot; calculations avoid floating-point arithmetic.

requirements.title: Do not expose a forbidden identity-to-ballot-choice mapping
requirements.acceptance: Public state and receipts prove inclusion, eligibility and aggregate outcome without publishing an identity-choice association where sealed-ballot rules apply.

requirements.title: Keep validator authority separate from political eligibility
requirements.acceptance: A validator who is outside the frozen civic electorate cannot vote; an eligible Tier-2 human does not require validator status.

requirements.title: Preserve public group reads with backend-enforced participation gates
requirements.acceptance: A nonmember can read public group state and content; only an eligible member can perform member-gated writes.

requirements.title: Complete backend and frontend suites from the implementation freeze
requirements.acceptance: All mandatory suites pass with zero skipped M3 journeys.

requirements.title: Tier-2 user creates a signed public post and reconciles finality
requirements.acceptance: The browser signs and submits the canonical transaction, tracks transaction status, and observes the committed post from a public read route.

requirements.title: Independent Tier-2 user joins a public group through the canonical membership request
requirements.acceptance: The client obtains, signs and submits GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_REQUEST; committed membership status is visible before member-gated posting unlocks.

requirements.title: Group member creates content while a nonmember retains public read access
requirements.acceptance: Member write succeeds, nonmember write fails, and both actors can read the committed group content.

requirements.title: Signed report creates a public reviewable dispute and deterministic reviewer assignments
requirements.acceptance: A signed report references committed content, creates a public dispute record, and assigns only conflict-free opted-in eligible reviewers.

requirements.title: Independent reviewers accept, attend and submit one final review ballot each
requirements.acceptance: Each selected reviewer uses an independent signing identity; duplicate votes and unauthorized reviewer actions fail.

requirements.title: Appeal uses the required fresh panel and produces an append-only final correction receipt
requirements.acceptance: An eligible affected actor files an appeal; panel reuse/conflicts are rejected; final outcome and correction history remain publicly inspectable.

requirements.title: Protected identity evidence remains excluded from broad civic routes
requirements.acceptance: Public report, group, content and governance routes contain commitments/outcomes but no raw PoH, government-ID, private-key or recovery material.

requirements.title: Eligible Tier-2 user creates and comments on a no-action civic proposal
requirements.acceptance: Creation and comments are signed, publicly visible, and do not imply approval, execution or finality.

requirements.title: Only frozen eligible humans or group members can cast one final ballot
requirements.acceptance: Eligible actors succeed with equal weight; ineligible, validator-only, duplicate, replacement and revoke attempts fail deterministically.

requirements.title: Block-height close, tally and finalization create traceable receipts
requirements.acceptance: Backend block height—not browser time—closes voting and publishes immutable snapshot, tally and finalization receipts.

requirements.title: Non-skippable independent-browser multi-actor civic/governance journey
requirements.acceptance: The journey uses independent browser contexts and canonical signed transactions; it cannot skip, use a demo seed, or call runtime appliers directly.

requirements.title: Restart and deterministic replay preserve the complete M3 final state
requirements.acceptance: Pre-restart and replayed civic state, receipts, electorate snapshot, dispute history and state root match.

requirements.title: Two nodes converge on identical M3 state and receipts
requirements.acceptance: Both nodes match chain identity, height, tip, state root, transaction index and the canonical M3 receipt set.

requirements.title: Observer catches up to the finalized M3 state without gaining authority
requirements.acceptance: Observer state matches the leader/follower final state while validator, reviewer and voter authority remain locked.

requirements.title: M3 scope and requirement traceability are machine checked
requirements.acceptance: Every scoped mechanism and requirement has a unique row, status, source/test mapping, acceptance condition and evidence family.

requirements.title: Implementation freeze and evidence-only direct child bind closure
requirements.acceptance: Evidence commit is the direct child of the recorded freeze and changes only the complete committed M3 evidence snapshot.

requirements.title: M3 mandatory journeys cannot be skipped or replaced by synthetic direct-apply proof
requirements.acceptance: Closure runner fails on Playwright skip/fixme, missing independent actor manifest, demo bootstrap, unsigned submission, direct applier use, or absent finality reconciliation.
